properties.note: The county divides Wade Township, which includes Newton, among all three districts. Its precincts changed after the 2020 census, and the county's map does not show clearly enough where the lines run outside the city, so this map cannot yet say which side a point is on.
Districts drawn where the county's own publication places whole precincts or townships. Shared: Wade Township (District 1 or District 2 or District 3).
properties.source: Census 2020 voting districts grouped by township, per Jasper County's "Redistricting County Board Effective 2022" and its certified 2024 General and 2026 General Primary returns
